hypothetical_cache_price_sensitivity.assumption: LLM cached input costs 0%, 20%, or 100% of each model's ordinary input list rate. These are hypothetical rates, not verified Nebius billing. Output and decision prices stay unchanged. Cache aliases are counted once; missing cache usage is unknown, never assumed zero. Full-rate estimates do not require cache detail.

mean_cost_difference_bootstrap95.method: paired percentile bootstrap of candidate minus baseline means

break_even.comparison: candidate cheaper above crossover; baseline cheaper below
break_even.scope: A common fraction of normal input price applies to every LLM model. A single USD-per-million crossover is reported only when ordinary input rates agree. No local compute, idle capacity or TCO is priced by this crossover.

local_active_model_hour_break_even.interpretation: Full-rate input/output price-model savings divided by additional local native total duration. Active time is not provisioned model-hours; idle hardware, electricity, hosting overhead and TCO are unmeasured. Total includes its components; do not add load or eval duration again. Unknown cost or local duration excludes the pair. Cached input is priced at the full input rate; this is not observed invoice savings.

accounting.cost_basis: Usage-based estimate at documented input/output list rates, pricing cached input at the full input rate. Cached-input billing is unverified. cost_usd_lower_bound is a known-usage subtotal/lower bound under this price assumption, not a lower bound on an actual invoice. Local hardware, electricity, idle capacity and hosting overhead are excluded.

Unknown cost or local duration excludes the pair. Cached input is priced at the full input rate; this is not observed invoice savings.
